CardDescription.DefaultText:
Should submerge hides in it within a tanning pit to transform them into leather.

It can be turned into red dye by adding enought mordant (lye or stale/aged urine).
CardDescription.Text: 应在鞣革坑中将兽皮浸入其中，使其变成皮革。\n\n通过添加足够的媒染剂（碱液或变质/陈化的尿液），可以将其变成红色染料。
